item.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A new study estimates only 2,000 U.S. engineers have the expertise to deliver meaningful AI ROI, as enterprises race to hire forward-deployed engineers to implement AI at scale.

item.title: In the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI’s hacker was noisy and fast — but not unstoppable
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Cybersecurity experts told TechCrunch that one of the biggest lessons to be taken from the OpenAI hack against HuggingFace has nothing to do with AI, but traditional cybersecurity defense.

item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: The Disrupt Stage is where many of the biggest conversations in technology happen, with a legacy that stretches back for more than a decade.

item.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patients’ medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The U.S. federal consumer watchdog said Hims & Hers, which prescribes for sexual wellness and mental health conditions, used website trackers to share customers' information with advertisers.

item.title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Federal safety regulators have given Zoox a temporary exemption that will allow the Amazon-owned autonomous vehicle technology company to charge customers for rides in its custom-built robotaxi.

item.description: Running Mode will be available to Premium users on iOS in select countries

item.title: Dili raises $21.7M to bring AI compliance to the infrastructure boom
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The Series A was led by Khosla Ventures, with participation from Allianz, Rebel Fund, Brick and Mortar Ventures’ Darren Bechtel, and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan.

item.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort

item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.

item.description: When Microsoft reported killer fourth-quarter earnings for its fiscal 2026 year (which ended June 30), it tucked in an interesting little tidbit about how its investments in the two biggest, and competing, AI labs are doing.

item.title: Waymo robotaxis are starting to return to freeways

item.description: The freeway pause — and its restart — comes amid increased scrutiny into Waymo and other robotaxi operators, particularly over how these self-driving vehicles behave in certain high-traffic situations and around emergency responders.

item.title: US government bans new foreign-made humanoids, robot dogs, and solar inverters, citing risks to national security
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The ban largely affects U.S. imports from China, which currently dominates the global market for making humanoid robots and solar inverters.
